Definition of done for agents, engines and the Tool Fabric.
Every capability maps to an approved engine/shared plane, workspace and tool manifest; no competing top-level engine model.
Every agent has principal, objective, allow-listed tools, data scope, max authority, risk/cost policy, human gate, expiry, audit and revocation.
Context, Intelligence and Authorized Work lanes can progress, pause and revoke independently; no lane infers authority from another.
Cross-tenant/object/function/property/action bypass suites pass; server-side checks apply at execution time.
All 202 registry items have stable IDs before production implementation, typed schemas, engine affinity, visibility, risk class and version lifecycle.
Material recommendations and verification results expose evidence, assumptions, uncertainty/confidence and human-review state.
Proposal -> structured agreement -> deliverable -> criterion verification -> human approval -> controlled release -> reconciliation is demonstrated without duplicate release.
Phishing, authz bypass, rate abuse, SSRF, upload, webhook/replay, KYC, payment and AI/tool-abuse tests pass at risk-appropriate depth.
Agent/tool/workflow traces, audit events, metrics, alerts and return-state reports are queryable and tenant-safe.
Authorized humans can inspect, redirect, pause, revoke and override progression; consequential action gates behave exactly as configured.
Public UI preserves progressive disclosure; no tool wall, no competing public engine products, and Growth remains expressed as outcome.
Agent/tool/engine contract changes are versioned, reviewed, migration-safe and traceable to ADR/change request.

New capability enters LAMID ONE through the Tool Fabric, an approved workflow/workspace, a bounded agent role, or a shared service. A new public module, new top-level engine, or broader authority model requires explicit architecture and product-governance approval; feature growth must not recreate taxonomy sprawl.
FINAL ARCHITECTURE PRINCIPLEContinuous Intelligence + Persistent Progression + Human Control. Progress may continue; authority does not silently migrate from the human or organization to the system.
